title: The source and target of the completed diagonal class
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $Y$ a scheme. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$, $W=P\times_Y P$, and let $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ be the diagonal. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}=\varprojlim_n(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_X$ and let $\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}(1)$ be the completed Tate line of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. Use modules over this completed ring sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and a chosen unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], in any localization universe for which it exists. Define the completed diagonal domain to be the degree-zero object $\Delta_*\mathbf Z_{\ell,P}[0]$, with its $\mathbf Z_{\ell,W}$-action restricted along the canonical inverse-image coefficient map induced by all finite quotient projections. Define its completed codomain to be $\mathbf Z_{\ell,W}(1)[2]$, namely the degree-zero completed Tate module followed by the positive shift two. These are objects, without a choice of an arrow between them and without an assertion that the endpoints are derived complete.
